evidence.description: The user's health evidence, passed in by the AI layer that holds their authorization. Source-neutral: normalize Apple Health / Garmin / Oura / Whoop / Strava into this shape. The server does not fetch or store evidence. Omit only for local demo runs.

healthMetrics.description: Recent readings: sleep_duration_hours, sleep_quality, hrv_ms, resting_hr_bpm, steps, stress — each with value, recordedAt, source.

workouts.description: Completed sessions with startedAt, durationMinutes, type, rpe, trainingLoad, muscleGroups.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today's demo date.

planId.description: Restrict the lookup to one plan. Defaults to searching the user's plans.

availableMinutes.description: Override today's available time, e.g. when the user says they are busy.

includeStravaFixture.description: Include the local Strava fixture as extra evidence.
